name: workstation-32c
description: Hypothetical two-die workstation NPU sized from Apple's published M3 Ultra figures (32-core Neural Engine, over 800 GB/s): two client-16c dies, 32 cores of 32x32 output-stationary arrays at 1.2 GHz (78.64 TOP/s), 667 B/cycle DRAM shared with the CPU and GPU, no die-to-die link modeled. Per core as client-16c: SRAM 256 KiB, depthwise datapath 128 MAC/cycle. Derivation: docs/design-points.md, section 5.
